mapper.select:
select t1.*, ifnull(t2.nick_name, t2.username) as user_name from user_book_list t1 left join user t2 on t1.user_id = t2.id
and t1.status = 1
and t1.list_name like concat('%', #{listName}, '%')
and t1.user_id = #{userId}
order by t1.create_time desc
mapper.insert: insert into user_book_list (user_id, list_name, description, book_count, status, create_time, update_time) values (#{userId}, #{listName}, #{description}, #{bookCount}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: update user_book_list set status = 0, update_time = now() where id = #{id}
update user_book_list set status = 0, update_time = now() where id in #{item}
update user_book_list t1 set t1.book_count = (select count(1) from user_book_list_item t2 where t2.list_id = t1.id), t1.update_time = now() where t1.id = #{listId}
